summary: Phase 2 (web hosting platform) tested end-to-end. 19/19 backend pytest tests pass; full frontend dashboard + admin flow verified via Playwright. JWT auth strict, private key encryption verified (plaintext + ciphertext never leak via GET /admin/config), WebSocket /api/ws handshake + initial state message confirmed. Bot start/stop, wallet generation, config persistence all functional.

issues: Once vault_address is set (even to a dummy hex), 'SETUP REQUIRED' banner disappears even though chain RPC is unreachable. Consider gating banner on real on-chain reachability (e.g. successful currentRound call) rather than mere presence of vault_address string.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Show 'SETUP REQUIRED' or a separate 'RPC UNREACHABLE' state when vault_address is set but on-chain calls fail (right now banner just disappears, leaving a 00:00 / 0.0000 dashboard with no explanation).

(Optional) /api/admin/wallet/generate returns private_key without '0x' prefix while imported keys keep their original format - consider normalizing to always-prefixed for UX consistency (Admin panel displays it as raw hex which is fine but inconsistent).
critical_code_review_comments: Security: keeper private key encryption with Fernet using sha256(ENCRYPTION_SEED) is correctly implemented; GET /api/admin/config strips both 'keeper_private_key' and the encrypted blob via pop() and exposes only keeper_private_key_set boolean. Verified.
Auth: HTTPBearer with PyJWT HS256, 24h expiry; missing token => 403, invalid token => 401. Consistent.
BotManager._run_loop catches exceptions and reports status='crashed' / 'rpc_error' / 'config_missing' instead of letting backend die when RPC is unreachable — good defensive design.
Single-file server.py is ~715 lines, approaching the 700-line threshold. If more endpoints are added, consider splitting into routers/admin.py, routers/game.py, services/bot.py.

ERC20_TRANSFER_TOPIC = Web3.keccak(...).hex() — in web3.py v7 returns no '0x' prefix; the matcher passes the topic to eth.get_logs which still accepts it, but consider explicit '0x'+hex normalization for forward compatibility.

The buyer-tracking heuristic in _scan_transfers identifies any non-zero, non-dead 'to' address as a buyer — fine for MVP, but a swap LP transfer can include unrelated addresses. Document this limitation for users.
test_credentials: Admin: admin / shootout2026 (env-driven, present in backend/.env). /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist - flagged.
seed_data_creation: Tests configured chain_id=97, dummy vault_address=0x12...90, dummy tax_token=0xab...cd, and generated a fresh Keeper wallet. Dashboard now shows configured=true even though chain is unreachable - expected for this preview env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 19 critical paths (public APIs, auth, config CRUD with PK encryption verification, wallet gen, bot lifecycle, WebSocket). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -p asyncio -o asyncio_mode=auto. Requires `pip install pytest-asyncio websockets`. WebSocket URL is BASE_URL with wss:// scheme + /api/ws.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial pytest failures were test-data mistakes (wrong expected ETH address derived from Hardhat key, and outdated assumption that Account.create().key.hex() returns 0x-prefixed string in eth_account >=0.13). Both fixed in test file; backend behaviour is correct.
